integration_wiring_2026_09_04.summary: Closed the loop between core modules: 016 validates → 021 selfHeals; 017 failures → 019 Planner steps

recovery_to_registry_2026_09_04.summary: Closed the full recovery loop: 016 heal → 017 planRecovery → 020 recordRecoveryAction
details: 020-module-registry: added recordRecoveryAction(moduleName, plan) — stores recovery plan (failureType, category, steps, risks, confidence, retryHint) in module.recovery_history (cap 20), sets status RECOVERY_PLANNED, exported via __NEXUS_REGISTRY__

016-hub-orchestrator: healUnhealthy() upgraded — after selfHeal, calls __NEXUS_EVOLUTION__.planRecovery() to get consensus plan, then __NEXUS_REGISTRY__.recordRecoveryAction() to track it; passes modState.errorType to selfHeal; results include recovery_plan
Full loop: failure detection → self-heal retry → consensus-based recovery plan → registry-tracked action with full audit trail
